analysis: Illustrative continuation scenarios for the four-indicator EU27 industrial leakage-risk screen
method: For each sector and indicator, fit a log-linear trend over 2008-2022, 2013-2022 and 2018-2022. Anchor each path on the observed 2022 value and compound its fitted annual rate through 2030.
scenario_interpretation: Historical-window sensitivities. The three paths are not probabilities, confidence intervals, or causal estimates.
limitations: The four-indicator common observed panel ends in 2022 because OECD modeled embodied-carbon data end in 2022 in the supplied extract.
Newer Eurostat data exist for some measures, but cannot update the full four-indicator comparison to a common year without extending the OECD embodied-carbon series.
This is an aggregate sector screen, not product-level emissions or a causal leakage estimate.
A fitted trend can differ from the endpoint change and may be especially sensitive in shorter windows.
The forecast holds historical growth rates constant and does not model policy, prices, technology, or structural breaks.
